forecasts.raw_text: North winds 10 to 15 knots, increasing to 20 to 25 knots. Seas 3 to 4 feet, building to 6 to 8 feet, occasionally to 10 feet. A chance of showers and thunderstorms after midnight, then a slight chance of thunderstorms this morning. Showers likely. A chance of thunderstorms this afternoon.
